name: barbell feet flat bench press
description: A bench press with your feet flat on the bench or surface instead of the floor, limiting leg drive and focusing on the chest.
instructions: Lie on a bench and place your feet flat on it, knees bent.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.
Keep your lower back flat and your core tight.
